experiment_label: Data-free Buckley-Leverett PINN with hard I/BC construction

value.problem: one-dimensional Buckley-Leverett hyperbolic conservation law for two-phase flow in porous media
value.entropy_treatment: Oleinik entropy condition described by repository README
value.data_free_goal: hard imposition of initial/boundary conditions through distance/particular functions

value.alternative_mode: M2 attention path implemented in notebook

notes: The representative notebook expects the reference MAT file at a Colab session-root path; the repository bundles the file under Data/, and the README instructs users to upload needed data files to Colab session storage.
